cues.text: Hypnotized into a crimson-stained delusion
Obfuscating what is true and what's illusion
Images all born of ill-contrived confusion
Till reality's unwelcomest intrusion
Waves are ever running short and running long
If it isn't clear, perhaps you've read them wrong
cues.translation: 선명하지 않다면 네가 잘못 읽은 걸지도 몰라

cues.text: Lunacy's contagious, breeding ever strong
Drawing victims deeper like a siren song
cues.translation: 사이렌의 노래처럼 희생자를 더 깊이 끌어당겨

cues.text: Full and bright as any night before?
What you don't expect may drive you mad.
cues.translation: 뜻밖의 것이 널 미치게 할지 몰라

cues.text: it drives you mad.
(This is all some kind of trick, just a trick that rabbits play...)
cues.translation: 이건 모두 토끼들이 벌인 속임수일 뿐

cues.text: MAD RED EYES, AND A FULL INVERTED MOON:
cues.translation: 미쳐 버린 붉은 눈과 거꾸로 선 보름달

cues.text: One which watches over and one which gazes through.
Turn away; it's a selfish sort of peace...
Seen or not, they still can see you.
cues.translation: 보이든 않든 그 눈은 여전히 널 보네

cues.text: MAD RED EYES, AND A FULL INVERTED MOON:
cues.translation: 미쳐 버린 붉은 눈과 거꾸로 선 보름달

cues.text: One which you behold, one withheld from naked sight.
cues.translation: 하나는 네 눈앞에 하나는 맨눈에 감춰진 채

cues.text: Turn away; but the madness lingers through
the end of the endless night--
Na na
